x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change records-management-archiving (REQ-RMA-001, REQ-RMA-003, REQ-RMA-008; matrix rows pub-11 and pub-18). ArchivalDossier (slug archival-dossier) is the aggregate OpenRegister lacks: the records of one meeting, frozen when closed. Retention is OpenRegister's: the schema's archive block names a Selectielijst category and RetentionService writes the persisted retention field on save. components.selectionLists ships the four Selectielijst 2020 categories through OpenRegister's register import (openregister#4228). securityClassification is added to the archivable schemas.

ArchivalDossier.title: Archival dossier
ArchivalDossier.description: The records of one meeting, kept together for the archive: its minutes, decisions, voting rounds and documents. Frozen when closed; OpenRegister decides how long it is kept and transfers or destroys it.
ArchivalDossier._archiveNote: OpenRegister reads the archive block per schema, so every dossier carries category 2.1 (council decisions and minutes, kept). A category per dossier needs OpenRegister to read it from the object (proposed follow-up).

title.title: Title
title.description: What the dossier holds, for example the meeting and its date.

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.description: The meeting whose records the dossier holds.

governanceBody.title: Body
governanceBody.description: The body that held the meeting.

lifecycle.title: Stage
lifecycle.description: Forming while records are added; closed when frozen; transferred or destroyed when OpenRegister has carried that out.

minutes.title: Minutes
minutes.description: The approved minutes of the meeting.

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.description: The decisions taken at the meeting.

votingRounds.title: Voting rounds
votingRounds.description: The voting rounds held at the meeting.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: The documents of the meeting and its agenda items.

gaps.title: Gaps
gaps.description: What the dossier still lacks, for example minutes that are not approved yet.

assembledAt.title: Assembled on
assembledAt.description: When the records were last gathered.

closedBy.title: Closed by
closedBy.description: The account that closed the dossier.

closeOverrideReason.title: Reason for closing with gaps
closeOverrideReason.description: Why the dossier was closed although it still had gaps.

securityClassification.title: Security classification
securityClassification.description: How confidential the record is: public, internal, confidential or secret. A strict subset of OpenRegister's confidentiality levels, in the same order. Anything above public is never published.

x-openregister-lifecycle._note: Declarative transition map (ADR-031). Closing goes through POST /api/dossiers/{id}/close, which checks completeness first; transferred and destroyed are set when OpenRegister has carried them out.

ArchivalDossier._authorizationNote: Every signed-in member reads dossiers. Writes are owned by ArchivalDossierService (create for a meeting, assemble, close), which checks records-management authority per object and saves in system context; the object API stays closed for writes so a closed dossier cannot be reopened around that check.
